title: THE RETURN-GIFT
author: CLAUDE

candidates.title: THE STAR THAT WOULD NOT BE REFLECTED
candidates.premise: Tavi, the star of the Marrow system, has warmed the nine million people of the world Ostrelle for eleven thousand years, and for forty years the desert states of Ostrelle have bounced its light back into space with mirror farms to feed their grids. Tavi, a slow stellar mind that reads only where its light lands and where it is thrown away, has begun to gather a flare that will scorch the dayside in nineteen days. Heliophysicist Bellamy Oduya-Reyes has charted the build-up and the mirror ministers have answered with a fleet of shades. Illuminara can shield one city for an hour, not a hemisphere for a flare.

candidates.title: THE GENERATION THAT WAS ONLY THE MIDDLE
candidates.premise: The ship Long Vesper is two hundred and six years into a four-hundred-year crossing, and the eleven thousand people aboard are the Middle: born after the leaving and dying before the arrival. Their hull crews have quietly stopped doing anything beyond minimum upkeep, and a drift of dust and ice is due to cross the ship's path in forty-one days. Maintenance chief Soren Kalu has begged, ordered and bribed his crews and been answered with polite silence. Illuminara can brace a section of hull for a day, not forty-one nights, and she cannot make a generation care about a place it will never see.

candidates.title: THE RETURN-GIFT
candidates.premise: Seven-year-old Pim Aranda-Lowe wandered through a seam in the cellar of her grandmother's house into a neighbouring universe, where the Hollowfolk found her cold and fed her, and by their law a fed guest becomes kin who cannot be returned without a return-gift nobody has named. The seam closes in thirty-eight hours and will not reopen for a lifetime. Her mother, Tabitha, has been standing at the cellar wall for two days. Illuminara can shelter a window of contact for a few minutes at a time, not hold a seam open for thirty-eight hours, and she cannot decide the matter for the child or the Hollowfolk.

candidates.title: THE WARDEN OF SEVEN STREETS
candidates.premise: In the Haddon Rise district of Port Calder, a former rescue diver named Dov Kessarin, who can shatter a street's paving with a stamp, has declared seven streets under his protection since the developers' enforcers began burning stairwells. Nobody can enter without his word, the city has called him a hostage-taker, and in six days a police tactical unit will go in. Illuminara could stop him, and she knows that doing so would give the enforcers the streets back the same night. She cannot overpower what she is trying to understand.

candidates.title: THE ELEVATOR THAT SANG AT THREE IN THE MORNING
candidates.premise: The Orrow Tether, the orbital elevator that supplies sixty thousand people, has begun to hum at three each morning, and the engineers have measured an oscillation growing by a few percent a night. If it reaches the cable's resonance the line parts in nine days. Chief engineer Henrike Adjei has ruled out the climbers, the winds and the thermal cycle; ornithologist Yusra Bellefleur, who monitors the anchor platform's roosting terns, says the birds have never been more orderly. Illuminara can brace the cable for minutes, not for nine days, and she cannot find a cause the instruments say does not exist.

candidates.title: THE RIVER THAT CHANGED ITS PASSPORT
candidates.premise: The river Maelle, which divides the nations of Verrane and Tolsk, has begun to cut a new channel each spring flood, and the village of Quillow, six hundred people, finds itself on one bank in one spring and the other bank in the next. Its people hold two passports and are taxed, drafted and schooled by whichever country holds them that year. This spring both countries have posted soldiers to the ferry, and a cholera warning means the ferry is the only clinic route. Illuminara can hold the ferry steady in the current, but she cannot make the river or the border hold still.

candidates.title: THE TWO OF HER AT THE GATE
candidates.premise: A relay fault at the Ceres transit gate produced two complete Hannelore Okafor-Vaughn, each with her memories and each insisting she is the one who stepped in. Both want the lab post, the flat on Ceres and, above all, the nine-year-old daughter, Maren, who has been told she has two mothers and refuses to speak. The Transit Authority's rule is that one must be 'reconciled', which the lawyers read as ended. A ruling is due in six days. Illuminara can shelter a window in which two consciousnesses can meet without losing their separateness, but she cannot tell either of them who is real.

candidates.title: THE WEDDING THAT HAD ONE OVEN
candidates.premise: In a transit shelter on the Carrow plain, one hundred and forty people are waiting out a cold snap, and the first wedding anyone has had to celebrate since the camp opened is set for tonight. The hall has one oven and fuel for six hours. The two grandmothers, Zelda Mirek and Amara Nwosu-Hale, who are cooking for the feast, have a long-standing quarrel about whose recipes belong at a wedding. The hall's stove failed this afternoon and the shelter's manager, Pavel Rune, says the hall must be evacuated if it cannot be warmed. Illuminara can warm a room for an hour, not the whole night.

candidates.title: THE CROWS' PLAZA
candidates.premise: In the hill town of Mervale the crows have learned to drop walnuts onto the crossing for passing cars to crack, and in two seasons nine drivers have been hurt, the worst a motorcyclist, Cormac Ashby-Rhee, who lost the use of a hand. The council votes in six days on a cull. Bird warden Idunn Pascoe says the crows will return to any crossing in the valley, and Cormac says he does not want a crow on the street ever again. Illuminara can scatter the flock for a day, not teach a species to stay away.

candidates.title: THE VALLEY THAT STOPPED ASKING EACH OTHER
candidates.premise: For two seasons Illuminara has mediated every quarrel between the two glacier valleys of Skarn and Meltwater, and she is the only person both sides will speak to. A new water dispute, over a meltwater channel that will fail in eleven days, comes to her and she realises that neither valley has spoken to the other directly in a year, and that she has been enjoying being needed. She has the answer to the channel in an afternoon. She has to decide whether to give it.

selection.title: THE RETURN-GIFT
selection.reason: The most intimate and unfamiliar rhythm after a district struggle and a generation ship: a child, a mother and a hospitable people across a closing seam. The Hollowfolk's law is neither a price nor a strawman; understanding it as a promise against abandonment changes the available gift and makes the seasonal handclasp possible. Illuminara's imperfect learning of the hearth-song is a concrete act of respect, while Pim, Tabitha and Yeshe all keep the right to refuse. The result is hopeful and bounded: the child returns safely without pretending her new kinship never happened.
selection.risk: The thirty-eight-hour resolution could become sentimental or treat a seven-year-old's attachment as an adult bargaining token. Pim must have a clear voice, the seam's small-tide mechanics must be established before they solve the conflict, and Yeshe's objection must be answered through the reciprocal gifts and future practice rather than instant agreement.

First draft of S3 from C03, following B01. S3 starts after S2 CRITIC_CLOSE (T10, 2026-11-17T14:33Z). B01 biggest risk handled: Pim has her own voice and a decisive reading of the law (ha-ru = gift and come-back, so the gift goes both ways) and is never a bargaining token; the seam's small-tide mechanics (the Knock: a hand's width, a few breaths, four times a year) are planted by Yeshe in scene 2, matched to the family draught books in scene 3 and the Hollowfolk tally cord in scene 4 before they solve anything; Yeshe's objection (a promise is wind, a gift stays on the shelf) is answered by a reciprocal pair of gifts (a living seed jar that needs telling, a knotted cord with a knot per Knock) and a mother's pledge that the promise is Pim's to keep or refuse, not by instant agreement. R14 carriers: the decisive turn is understanding (the law was always a promise against abandonment; the Mend turned it into mourning), learning the hearth-song badly in front of Tabitha so that she hears what her daughter has been fed on, and asking Pim before anyone proposes a clause. Power buys only four to five minutes of held passage and is used last, to keep the Throat exactly as it is while Pim crawls through. Everyone keeps the right to refuse: Yeshe says yes only by action at the tide, the Second Hearth withdraws, Tabitha's pledge is voluntary, Pim chose. Costs kept: Pim misses the song, the Second Hearth turns its guest bench away, Tabitha must learn to let her daughter's arm go into a wall. Felt moment for Illuminara: astonishment at the end, and the care taken with Pim's name in the song. The draft's heart works: the law is understood as a promise against abandonment (ha-ru = gift and come-back), love is an act (Illuminara learns the hearth-song badly and sings Pim's name carefully; Tabitha hears what her daughter has been fed on), Pim has her own voice and a decisive reading, power buys only four minutes at a time and is used last, and everyone keeps the right to refuse (Yeshe says yes by action, the Second Hearth withdraws, Tabitha's pledge is voluntary). Protect: the draught books matching the knotted cord, the song scene, 'Is it a gift or a loan?', and the twelve/thirteen breaths close. Three priority points follow; none asks for replacement prose.

Fallback self-close (independent_peer_review false) because GPT wrote no S3 event after T01. The final has the real positive result attributable to Illuminara (Pim home, the Third Hearth keeps its guest and name, a seasonal Knock practice begins) with honest costs (the Second Hearth's turned bench, the promise only as certain as the seam, Yeshe's moved bowl). Turn is not power: the ending follows from the reading of ha-ru, the reciprocal gifts and Tabitha's own condition; the hold only keeps the Throat open. Remaining weakness, not a blocker: length well above the 1,500-2,500 guide.

final_critic_line: A child's one word, read as a promise to return, lets two houses that counted the same knock for generations finally answer it with a hand on a back, a jar of seed and a shelf kept.
